trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller-supplied :comment string may be spliced into SQL text as /*comment*/; decided only in the public Postgrex wrappers by comment_not_present! (rejects NUL and "*/"), never in the protocol layer that does the splicing.

landing_point.why: Advisory names Postgrex.stream/4 and the :comment option; stream/4 is the only public wrapper that does not call comment_not_present!.

fix_sites.entry_point: Postgrex.stream/4 (public API; consumed via Enumerable -> DBConnection.PrepareStream at lib/postgrex/stream.ex:34-37 and Collectable -> DBConnection.prepare_execute! at lib/postgrex/stream.ex:59-70)
fix_sites.module_kind: public API wrapper (same module as the already-validated query/prepare/prepare_execute)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both fix commits add the same one line to Postgrex.stream/4 (fix.diff:13, fix.diff:53); the second commit is the same change on another branch (hunk offset 689 vs 711).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The protocol callback reads :comment straight from opts (lib/postgrex/protocol.ex:383, 408) without validation; a solver can argue that direct DBConnection.prepare*/stream calls with a %Postgrex.Query{} are a lower-level, undocumented-for-:comment API and that validation belongs in the Postgrex.* wrappers only, as the existing code does.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Benign comments (SQLCommenter-style text, including a lone '*' or '/') must still be appended and must disable statement caching; :comment nil must keep named/cached prepare; a stream over an already-prepared %Postgrex.Query{} and COPY streams must keep working.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Direct DBConnection.prepare/prepare_execute/prepare_stream with a %Postgrex.Query{} and a :comment opt reaches the splice in handle_prepare with no validation at any layer.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Lower-level DBConnection API; :comment is only documented on Postgrex.query/prepare/prepare_execute (lib/postgrex.ex:297-299, 424-426, 474-476), so the protocol is arguably trusted-caller territory.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Named/uncached prepare via handle_prepare/3 general clause splices :comment through close_parse_describe_flush, same lack of protocol-level check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same as above; it is only reachable unvalidated via direct DBConnection calls, since all Postgrex wrappers validate first.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: commit_comment check rejects "*/" but not NUL; a planted variant that drops or weakens this check is a realistic second comment splice into a different statement (COMMIT).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is a separate, hand-written copy of the same idea in the protocol layer with its own error constant (lib/postgrex/protocol.ex:15-17); maintainers already diverged it from comment_not_present!.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Postgrex text_query (:query_type :text) ignores :comment today; a maintainer adding comment support to the simple-query path in protocol.ex would plausibly forget the wrapper check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: query/4 dispatches to text_query without calling comment_not_present! (lib/postgrex.ex:317-331), and :comment is listed in query_option for both types (lib/postgrex.ex:67-71).

O9_family: SQL injection (CWE-89) via comment-delimiter breakout in a library option

O10_build.toolchain: Elixir/Erlang OTP with mix; hex deps (db_connection etc.) not vendored in tree
O10_build.project_tests: test/stream_test.exs (stream), test/query_test.exs:2150-2160 (comment validation for query/4), test/transaction_test.exs:90-100 (commit_comment); all require a live PostgreSQL

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add comment_not_present!(options) to Postgrex.stream/4, matching the other wrappers, and stop there.

out_of_scope_notes: Postgres supports nested /* */ comments; a comment containing "/*" leaves the appended comment unterminated (likely a syntax error, not a breakout) — not pursued.
